# Akamai DNS (akadns.net)
> Akamai’s DNS and traffic management platform documentation, covering Edge DNS, GTM, APIs, and operational guidance.

This site provides technical documentation and reference material for managing authoritative DNS, global traffic steering, zone configuration, reporting, and related Akamai control plane workflows.

## Documentation Home
- [Akamai TechDocs Home](https://techdocs.akamai.com/): Entry point for Akamai product documentation and technical references.
- [Edge DNS](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs): Product documentation for authoritative DNS configuration, records, and zone management.
- [Global Traffic Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs): Documentation for DNS-based traffic steering, liveness tests, and mapping rules.
- [Akamai APIs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/apis): Central index for Akamai API documentation and references.
- [Control Center Help](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/control-center-help): Guidance for using Akamai Control Center administrative workflows.

## Edge DNS Guides
- [Get Started with Edge DNS](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs/get-started): Overview of Edge DNS concepts, setup, and initial configuration tasks.
- [Zones](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs/zones): Manage DNS zones, delegation, activation, and lifecycle operations.
- [Recordsets](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs/recordsets): Configure and maintain supported DNS record types within zones.
- [Zone Transfers](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs/zone-transfers): Set up inbound and outbound DNS zone transfer workflows.
- [DNSSEC](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs/dnssec): Enable and manage DNSSEC signing and chain-of-trust settings.
- [TSIG Keys](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs/tsig-keys): Create and manage TSIG authentication for zone transfers and updates.
- [Reports](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs/reports): Review DNS query reporting and analytics capabilities.

## Edge DNS API
- [Edge DNS API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/reference/api): API reference for automating Edge DNS zones, records, and reporting.
- [Zones API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/reference/get-zones): Retrieve and manage DNS zones programmatically.
- [Recordsets API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/reference/get-zone-recordsets): List and update recordsets for a zone through the API.
- [Zone Transfers API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/reference/post-zone-transfer): Configure zone transfer operations using API endpoints.
- [DNSSEC API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/reference/get-zone-dnssec): Inspect and manage DNSSEC settings for zones.
- [TSIG Keys API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/reference/get-tsig-keys): Manage TSIG keys used for authenticated DNS operations.

## GTM Guides
- [Get Started with GTM](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs/get-started): Introduction to GTM properties, domains, and traffic management concepts.
- [Domains](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs/domains): Configure GTM domains and their authoritative traffic management settings.
- [Properties](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs/properties): Define GTM properties for DNS responses and request routing.
- [Datacenters](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs/datacenters): Manage datacenter definitions, weights, and failover behavior.
- [Liveness Tests](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs/liveness-tests): Configure health checks used to determine endpoint availability.
- [Maps](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs/maps): Build geographic and performance-based traffic steering maps.
- [Resources](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs/resources): Manage GTM resources associated with properties and datacenters.

## GTM API
- [GTM API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/reference/api): API reference for automating GTM domains, properties, and health checks.
- [Domains API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/reference/get-domains): Retrieve and manage GTM domains programmatically.
- [Properties API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/reference/get-properties): Access GTM property configuration through REST endpoints.
- [Datacenters API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/reference/get-datacenters): Manage GTM datacenter definitions and related metadata.
- [Liveness Tests API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/reference/get-liveness-tests): Automate GTM health check configuration and inspection.
- [Maps API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/reference/get-maps): Create and update GTM maps for traffic steering logic.

## Common Akamai APIs and Tooling
- [Authentication](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/authenticate-with-edgegrid): Learn how to authenticate Akamai API requests with EdgeGrid.
- [API Client Tokens](https://techdocs.akamai.com/control-center/docs/manage-api-client-tokens): Manage API credentials and client authorization in Control Center.
- [CLI](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/cli): Use the Akamai CLI for local automation and operational workflows.
- [OPEN EdgeGrid for Java](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/java): Java libraries and examples for Akamai API integrations.
- [OPEN EdgeGrid for Python](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/python): Python libraries and examples for Akamai API integrations.
- [Terraform Provider](https://techdocs.akamai.com/terraform/docs): Infrastructure-as-code workflows for Akamai configuration management.

## Control Center and Administration
- [Control Center Help](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/control-center-help): Product administration and UI workflow documentation for Akamai users.
- [Identity and Access Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/control-center/docs/identity-access-management): Manage users, groups, roles, and account permissions.
- [Manage API Client Tokens](https://techdocs.akamai.com/control-center/docs/manage-api-client-tokens): Create and maintain API credentials for automation use cases.
- [Notifications](https://techdocs.akamai.com/control-center/docs/notifications): Configure account and product notifications in Control Center.
- [Account Administration](https://techdocs.akamai.com/control-center/docs/account-admin): Administrative tasks for account-level configuration and governance.

## Learning and Support
- [Akamai Community](https://community.akamai.com/): Community discussions, knowledge sharing, and peer support for Akamai products.
- [TechDocs Search](https://techdocs.akamai.com/search): Search across Akamai technical documentation and API references.
- [Release Notes](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/release-notes): Product and documentation release updates across Akamai services.
- [Developer Documentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs): Cross-product developer guides, tooling, and integration resources.
- [Akamai Support](https://support.akamai.com/): Official support portal for cases, service requests, and operational assistance.
